Green. The color green pertains to fruitful and living things, speaking of both spiritual things and physical things (Job 15:32; Jer. 11:16-17; Hosea 14:8; Ps. 37:2; D&C 135:6).
quotes.attr: Joseph Fielding Mc Conkie and Donald W. Parry, A Guide to Scriptural Symbols, p.62
